lines: Add basic information about the role you are creating
Set permissions that determine what users in this role can see and do.
Manage work orders the core operational records in ShopView.
Controls interface complexity, not access controls.

Complete interface with all fields visible and editable (subject to CRUD permissions). The estimate column shows the actual estimate value. Full parts request form with all fields. All workflow actions available (approve, review, split etc...).
Add, edit, and remove the individual labor and part lines on a work order.
View and manage scheduled jobs across the shop calendar.
Access and maintain customer records and contact details.
Generate invoices and record payments against work orders.
Track and review technician labor hours and time entries.
Manage parts inventory, catalog, sales, and vendor operations.
Performance statistics, labor/parts/total reports, and analytics
Customer facing portal configuration and management.
Access to the Accounting module. Financial areas can expose compensation data. Grants here are never implied by other permissions.
Allows opening the Accounting module. Without it, no accounting permission below has any effect.
Customers, invoices, payments, credit memos and refunds.
Vendors, bills, vendor payments and vendor credits.
Bank transactions, rules, batch deposits and subscriptions. Shows money movement, including payroll.
Chart of accounts and journal entries.
Financial reports (P&L, balance sheet, aging). Can include wage and compensation data.
Chart-of-account mappings, fiscal periods, company info, and workspace administration.
Controls visibility of pricing, cost, and margin data across work orders, parts, and invoices.

Controls visibility of unpaid invoices, payments and credits tabs on customer and vendor pages. Without this setting the following fields are hidden on the Edit Customer modal: Credit terms, Credit limit, Default Labor rate, Default Shop Supplies, Min and Max, Taxes, PO is required.
